name: ridd-sales-platform
description: RIDD Sales Platform — static PWA on Netlify + one Express service on Cloud Run (server/). Netlify Functions remain until each is ported; see MIGRATION.md.

scripts.check: node app/scripts/bundle.js && node app/scripts/ci-check.js && node app/scripts/build-engine.js && node packages/engine/test/smoke.js
scripts.build: node app/scripts/bundle.js && node app/scripts/ci-check.js && node app/scripts/build-engine.js && node packages/engine/test/smoke.js && node app/scripts/build.js
scripts.tailwind: cd app && npx --yes tailwindcss@3.4.17 -c tailwind.config.js -i src/styles/tailwind.in.css -o public/tailwind.css --minify
